title: Flow with callouts
summary: Columns along a path, left to right, each carrying the callouts that sit on it: what leaks or breaks there, in plain words, with the decision or open item that fixes it. A callout is solid when this design fixes it and dashed when it is left for a later design; the renderer writes the legend from those two statuses, shows `by` as the entry's handle, measures every label, and spaces the columns to their callouts, so nothing overlaps.
belongs: A compare panel whose figure lays findings along a request path; a callout's topic names the .xs-topic row it explains, and the two highlight each other.

col.description: the id of the column this callout sits on

title.description: the thing that leaks or breaks at this stage, in plain words

status.description: fixed when this design fixes it, later when it is left for a follow-up design

by.description: the id of the decision or open item that fixes it, shown as that entry's handle, or a phrase of six words or fewer

side.description: which side of the column; unset callouts go above, the fourth and later below

topic.description: the .xs-topic text of the compare row this callout explains

arrows.description: arrows between consecutive columns; on unless set to false
